coordinate_convention: Zero-based, half-open genomic intervals; routing positions are offsets within each 12,800-bp window.
selection: Upper routing tracks are fixed illustrative windows selected for visible routing changes. Lower relative Token density charts pool a separate, fixed, model-independent cohort of 749 evaluation windows per species; see region_density_cohort.
annotations: Region labels from the existing GENCODE datasets; NIG and DIG merged as Intergenic only for display. Tandem repeats annotated post hoc using TRF 2 7 7 80 10 50 500.
checkpoints_usage: Original 11-checkpoint A100 export retained for the tandem-repeat animation and reference comparisons. The region animation selects ten actual tracks from region_checkpoints, as recorded in region-animation-frames.json.
original_sequence_definition: Original bp shares pooled over the same 749 fixed windows per species form the denominator of relative Token density. The 1× reference means equal token and original bp shares; it is not a 0B checkpoint.

region_inference_provenance.input: Raw DNA and boolean mask only; model.eval(); no region annotations or routing_step.
region_inference_provenance.shared_inference: All eleven checkpoints were re-evaluated with the same historical inference implementation and H100 environment.

region_plot.x_axis: Logarithmic training-base axis using actual logged counts; overlapping step-3000 counts are averaged with equal source weights.
region_plot.metric: pooled fractional token share / pooled original bp share across all windows
region_plot.token_assignment: fraction of token span overlapping each region
region_plot.display_rule: One connected display, without source-run markers. Duplicate step-3000 density values are averaged equally after pooling each source; this combined display is not a single-run training trace.
region_plot.checkpoint_identity: The pair (source_run, step) identifies an input checkpoint. Eleven source checkpoints become ten displayed frames.
region_plot.early_observation: At the first five early-rerun checkpoints (approximately 0.1–2B), all 749 windows per species retain eight final-stage tokens. Fractional regional assignment uses complete token spans.

region_published_reference_comparison.reference: Original A100 export retained in checkpoints.
region_published_reference_comparison.comparison: Ordered genomic boundary positions for four published checkpoints, four fixed windows and two stages.
region_published_reference_comparison.interpretation: Diagnostic comparison only; the cause of boundary differences is not established. The region animation consistently uses the new H100 tracks.

region_notes: All checkpoints use the same historical inference code and GPU in this export.
Early rerun and published checkpoints are independent training trajectories. Source identities are preserved in data; the combined animation omits run labels and averages overlapping density values.
Four fixed Human/Mouse windows; raw DNA only, model.eval(), no annotations or routing_step.
Early bases use saved trainer counters; published bases use the original logged manifest.
Comparisons with the previous A100 export are diagnostic and do not replace these fresh tracks.

The first five rerun checkpoints (steps 31, 61, 153, 305 and 611; approximately 0.1–2B bases) retain eight final-stage tokens in each fixed window, matching the configured minimum. Their token shares change in increments of 12.5 percentage points.

Independent checkpoints at nearly the same training budget yield different final-stage token counts and regional token shares. The displayed 10B density point averages their pooled values; the upper illustration uses actual published routing. Discrete boundaries are not averaged.

region_overlap_comparison.interpretation: Independent checkpoints at nearly the same training budget yield different final-stage token counts and regional token shares. The displayed 10B density point averages their pooled values; the upper illustration uses actual published routing. Discrete boundaries are not averaged.
region_overlap_comparison.scope: Two upper illustrative windows; these are retained-boundary statistics, not the 749-window pooled fractional density statistics.

region_notes_scope: region_notes, region_inference_provenance, region_published_reference_comparison and region_overlap_comparison describe the upper illustrative routing tracks. Lower curves use region_density_cohort and its fractional pooled metric.
region_density_definition: pooled fractional token share / pooled original bp share across all windows

plotted_metric.metric: pooled fractional token share / pooled original bp share across all windows
plotted_metric.token_assignment: fraction of token span overlapping each region
plotted_metric.absent_region: contributes zero regional bp/tokens to pooled totals

plot_merge.weighting: equal weight per source checkpoint, after pooling windows
plot_merge.provenance: source_count and source_provenance retained in the merged table; per-run tables unchanged

plotted_metric.inference: existing forward outputs; no reverse-complement averaging
plotted_metric.table9_relation: same fractional allocation; pooled cohort statistic rather than Table 9 per-window mean; different cohort and inference protocol

region_density_cohort.raw_export_scope: The input JSON preserves the original exporter output, including boundary-count mean-share diagnostics. Its method, rows and notes describe those raw diagnostics. The plotted curves are recomputed from its per-window token spans using the fractional pooled method specified in region-token-density-method.json.

region_animation.overlap_rule: At step 3000, lower density values and training bases are the equal-weight mean of both sources; upper illustrative routing uses the real published checkpoint. Discrete routing boundaries are never averaged.
region_animation.animation: Ten checkpoints at 450 ms each, followed by 3 seconds of in-place density emphasis at the unchanged final checkpoint; no temporal interpolation or smoothing.
region_animation.routing_display: Both stages use region-colored boundary lines; compact-token row removed.
